description:
Use this when the user asks how an Indian company is exposed to a macro factor such as crude oil, rates or currency, with official context signals.

Return cached company macro pathway evidence and eligible official context signals.

    Signals are emitted only when an active, reviewed, sourced company exposure passes the
    factor policy against a complete official PPAC Indian Basket or FBIL USD/INR window. This is
    conditional context only: it never states that a macro move caused or will cause an earnings,
    price, or investment outcome. Missing evidence is returned as explicit coverage, not inferred.
name: get_company_macro_exposures
title: Macro exposure signals
